name: Ají (Colombian-Style Tomato and Onion Salsa)

ingredients.name: roma tomatoes, cut into 1/2- to 1/4-inch dice
loosely packed fresh cilantro leaves, finely chopped

instructions.primary_message: Combine tomatoes, scallions, cilantro, and chili in a small bowl. Season generously with salt and let sit 2 minutes until salt dissolves. Add water and stir to combine.

schema_metadata.keywords: aji, colombian cuisine, Latin American cuisine, quick, salsa, sauce

description: Like Mexican salsas, there are countless variations of this Colombian sauce: some made with hot chilies, some with avocados, some with pumpkin seeds, even some made with hard boiled eggs. But, as with Mexican salsa, there is one that immediately comes to most people's minds when they hear the word. In this case, it's the tomato and onion-based ají.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 serrano or jalapeño chile, seeds and stems removed, finely chopped (optional)

Make-ahead and storage: Ají can be eaten immediately or stored in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
